messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: metering.census.delta = 3.8% for eu1 - divergence between live emitter and shadow census. Auto-created incident #9876.

sam-oncall: Ack. I'm oncall for this window. Looking.

maria-billing: I can take billing-side triage. Noted increased overflag rate from last 2 hrs.

ops-jen: Seeing delayed usage batch ingestion in region eu1 (kafka consumer lag ~ 18m). Could be upstream backlog.

leo-eng: Any recent deploys? I saw a small KV-prefix refactor landed ~03:10 UTC.

maria-billing: Confirmed. KV-prefix change in emitter routing at 03:09 UTC (pr #412). Rollout was gradual.

sam-oncall: @leo-eng can you check if that refactor affects partitioning/keys?

leo-eng: Quick grep shows new prefix path includes tenant -> service tag reorder. Might change shard affinity.

maria-billing: If shard affinity changed, shadow emitter and live emitter could diverge token counts due to routing to stale partitions. That matches the census delta.

ops-jen: Running consumer-lag query for emitter topic now:
```
SELECT partition, lag_seconds FROM consumer_lag WHERE topic='usage-emitter-eu1' LIMIT 10;
# results: partitions 2,3,7 show lag 900-1100s
```

sam-oncall: Customer impact check? @annie-cs please stand by for possible customer-facing notes.

annie-cs: Watching. Early signal: about 120 customers may see delayed usage reports; overage email triggers for ~8 accounts (likely false positives). Preparing a templated note.

leo-eng: I can hotfix emitter to use old prefix mapping (rollback) and restart a canary of the emitter. ETA ~12m for rollout to canary.

maria-billing: In parallel, I'll enable conservative count fallback in billing aggregator (use shadow fallback=false -> true) to suppress auto overflagging. Flipping flag now.

maria-billing: flag flip done: billing.consensus.fallback = true. This should prevent new overage alerts.

deploy-bot: deploy start: emitter-service v3.5.1 -> v3.5.2-rollback-canary (canary nodes: eu1-a).

sam-oncall: Good. Monitor token delta after canary. baseline before fix: emitter-census delta 3.8%.

ops-jen: Post-canary logs show partitioning reverted for canary, consumer-lag down to ~120s on canary nodes.

leo-eng: Canary looks clean. Plan: rollout to 50% then full if metrics stable for 10m.

maria-billing: Running a quick reconciliation between live and shadow for last 6h to estimate retrospective impact.

maria-billing: Reconciliation summary (approx): ~0.9% undercount across EU tenants in 03:10-04:40 window -> explains ~120 delayed reports. Overflag false positives triggered on 8 accounts due to spike in reported tokens.

annie-cs: Draft note ready. Will not send CS blast yet — wait for final reconciliation numbers. For affected accounts we should proactively message with apology + ETA for correction.

sam-oncall: Action items: 1) finish rollout 2) full consumer-lag backfill for stalled partitions 3) run backfill reconciliation job and emit corrected usage 4) CS outreach for 8 accounts.

leo-eng: Rollout to 50% -> 100% complete. No other regressions flagged.

ops-jen: Kafkactl replay started for partitions 2,3,7. ETA for backfill completion ~25m.

maria-billing: Kick off billing-reconcile job (job id: br-9876) to compute corrected deltas and generate corrected invoices/usage events.

maria-billing: br-9876 started. Estimated run time 18m.

anne-cs: (typo) -> annie-cs: CS message queued for 8 accounts, we will wait for br-9876 success before sending.

sam-oncall: Good progress. Initial mitigation prevents further false overflags. Remaining risk: customers seeing delayed reporting but no sustained overcharges expected.

leo-eng: After br-9876 completes, I'll run a spot-check script to validate token parity across 50 sample tenants.

maria-billing: br-9876 finished successfully. Generated corrected usage events; pushed to billing correction queue.

ops-jen: Backfill replay finished. Consumer lag normalized.

leo-eng: Spot-checks on sample tenants show parity within 0.02%. Census delta resolved.

annie-cs: Sending CS emails to affected 8 accounts now with explanation and expected credit if needed. Template: brief apology, explanation (routing refactor caused temporary routing mismatch -> delayed usage -> corrected), actions taken, contact link.

sam-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. Will keep incident open for postmortem doc and followup (owner: leo-eng + maria-billing).

incident-bot: Incident #9876 status -> mitigated. Postmortem requested: owner assigned leo-eng.

sam-oncall: Notes for postmortem: avoid prefix-rollouts without partition affinity check; add automated parity check after emitter rollout; add guard to suppress overflagging for short-lived diverges.

annie-cs: Customer impact: delayed reports for ~120 customers (1-2h delay), 8 false overage emails — credits queued.

sam-oncall: Passing to next oncall for overnight watch: @maria-billing (oncall handoff).

maria-billing: Taking handoff. Will monitor billing corrections and CS replies.

sam-oncall: Thanks team. Closing live triage thread.
